title: Kimchi Jamaican Bowl
description: A flavorful and energizing bowl filled with spicy kimchi, jerk chicken, and amazing sauce.

ingredients.name: Amazing Sauce
ingredients.notes: see notes for homemade amazing sauce recipe

instructions: Season the chicken with jerk seasoning and cook in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, cook the coconut rice according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked chicken, kimchi, cilantro, coconut rice, and sliced jalapeno peppers.
Drizzle the amazing sauce over the top of the bowl and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice, if desired.
